summary.supported_systemic_observation: Across these four cases, direct factual UAV attack wording is episode-specific, exact-city and temporally bound, but the Sumy historical adapter does not promote 'атакував/атакували' into the accepted strike role. The fresh replay therefore reports NO_STRICT_EXPLOSION_EVIDENCE and AIR_CONTEXT_NOT_LINKED_TO_EVENT even though v2 accepts strike independently of explosion.

implementation_scope.current_legacy_gate: In the Sumy branch, the historical event-role boolean accepts strict_attack_event_signal plus explicit 'вдар/ударив/завдав авіаудар' forms but deliberately does not recognize factual 'атакував/атакували' wording. Without that event role, review provenance exposes no explosion_evidence and no same_attack_basis, so classify_candidate fails base_event_ok.
implementation_scope.proposed_v2_acceptance_rule: For retained Sumy historical evidence, recognize a direct factual 'атакув...' statement as v2 strike only when the same retained statement provides exact-city and military/UAV attack context and the existing reviewed temporal binding is episode-specific. Treat the direct statement as self-contained event/attack binding; do not require a second statement to establish same-attack context. Do not broaden warnings, predictions or threat-only wording.
implementation_scope.why_this_is_smallest: Existing monitor classification already accepts a reviewed event role with exact-city, air context and episode-specific temporal proof; once the direct retained attack sentence is promoted to strike/event evidence, the same sentence can supply the intrinsic same-attack basis without changing general live-classifier behavior.
not_justified_by_these_four_cases: No separate air_defense_action implementation change is justified by these four cases because none relies on PPO activity.
No external source recovery is required for these four v2 determinations.
required_regression_tests: Positive retained-text fixtures for all four target excerpts: each must resolve as v2 strike with the same episode-specific binding.
Verify all four target IDs leave historical QA after the shared adapter fix, with denominator unchanged.
Verify b103be64497fc7d33f5c7b3d and d6b1b9ffc10dafbc86e253c7 remain absent from QA.
Verify the other 15 current Sumy QA IDs do not change solely because of this targeted direct-strike rule unless their retained text independently satisfies the same rule.
Negative threat/warning controls: 'можлива атака', 'загроза удару', predicted PPO activity, or generic same-date Sumy context must not become event-positive.
Negative geography/temporal controls: region-only wording or an attack outside the bound alert must not become event-positive.
implementation_scope.expected_effect_on_four_targets: All four should be accepted as v2 event-positive strike episodes and should no longer remain in historical QA solely because strict_explosion/same_attack_context legacy roles are absent. No denominator change is expected.
